links.outcome: Readability (reading difficulty score) of chatbot answers to patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o had the highest reading difficulty score (14.22, p < 0.05), suggesting a middle school reading level or above.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o had the highest reading difficulty score (14.22, post hoc Dunnett test, p < 0.05), suggesting a middle school reading level or above.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Gemini, etc.) using physician exam questions and interactive patient questions rated by patients and clinicians for safety, accuracy, and readability, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
